# API Design

## Resources

- Nouns, not verbs: `/orders/{id}`, not `/getOrder`.
- Use HTTP methods for intent (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) and status codes for outcome.
- Plural collections; stable, opaque ids.

## Contracts

- Consistent error shape: `{ error, message, details }`.
- Paginate lists; never return unbounded result sets.
- Version from day one (`/v1`) and add fields additively.

## Hygiene

- Validate input at the edge; return 4xx with a clear message.
- Idempotent PUT/DELETE; document side effects.
- Never leak internals or secrets in errors.
